item.title: Sen. Reed backs Iran war powers vote, says Trump is ignoring Constitution
item.description: U.S. Sen. Jack Reed said Sunday he will vote in favor of a war powers resolution requiring President Trump to halt military action against Iran within 30 days, criticizing the White House for going to war without authorization from Congress.
